finish_summary:
1) parse_coupon implementation does not handle case-insensitive coupon codes as specified; it raises ValueError for valid lowercase input.
2) Cart.subtotal incorrectly applies bulk discount when the same item is added in separate calls: it aggregates quantities and discounts only based on total quantity, while spec expects each line’s quantity to be considered independently (so first 5 units no discount then new 10 units get 5%). This leads to a subtotal of 142.5 instead of expected 237.5.
